snippet.description:

중국집에서 곁들임으로 주는 만두가 대부분 이런 제품이래요. 기름에 지져주면 겉이 바삭해져서 짜장면 옆에 놓던 그 맛 그대로예요.

🌶️ 물에 타기만 하면 짬뽕 국물 완성!
불맛 나는 가루라서 풀기만 해도 걸쭉한 짬뽕 국물이 뚝딱 나와요. 이걸 알고 나면 짬뽕은 굳이 시켜 먹게 되지 않더라고요 ㅋㅋ

🦐 건더기 걱정 없는 국산 해물!
국내산이라 자주 먹게 되는 해물이에요. 여러 종류가 잘게 다져져 들어 있어서 건더기 푸짐한 짬뽕 느낌이 나요.

🍝 딱 1분만 삶으면 끝나는 중식면!
냉동 면이라 1분만 삶아서 국물에 넣으면 돼요. 배달 중국집 열 곳 중 아홉보다 맛있다고 자신 있게 말할 수 있어요 ㅋㅋ

🍚 자매품 짜장가루도 있어요!
재료만 볶다가 풀어주면 짜장면도, 짜장밥도 어렵지 않게 만들 수 있어요. 일요일엔 우리 집이 중국집이 되는 거죠!

.

snippet.title: أحد يناديني من ورا الطعس بصوت أمي… وأمي في البيت 😱 (الجزء 1)  #قصص_رعب #roblox
snippet.description:
في البر، عندنا قانون: إذا سمعت أحد يناديك باسمك من ورا الطعس في الليل… لا ترد. ولا تلتفت.
طلعنا كشتة: أنا، وجدي، وولد عمي سعود 🔥
الساعة وحدة بالليل، سمعت صوت أمي من ورا الطعس: يا يوسف… تعال. بس أمي في البيت، مية كيلو من هني.
جدي قال: عدّ الفناجين. عدّيت… وفيه واحد زيادة 👀
ضيف لابس شماغ، قاعد بيني وبين سعود. وجدي همس: لا تطالع رجوله.
والنار طفت… وسعود قام ومشى للصوت.
1 ألحق سعود، ولا 2 أقعد مع جدي لين الفجر؟ اكتب رقمك، والأكثر يقرر الجزء الثاني 👇
تبي اسمك في الجزء الجاي؟ لايك وكومنت، ويمكن أختار تعليقك 🔥

snippet.title: Duterte case must be handled by PH courts, not ICC — defense lawyers
snippet.description:
Good evening.
You’re watching The Manila Times’ News Prime.

Today is November 26th.

Our top story:

Lawyers of former President Rodrigo Duterte have acknowledged that unlawful killings occurred during his administration’s anti-drug campaign.


However, they argued that these did not constitute crimes against humanity and should instead be prosecuted in Philippine courts.
They maintained that the prosecution had failed to establish the legal elements necessary to bring the case under Article 7 of the Rome Statute.
In particular, Duterte’s lawyers argued that the alleged killings did not form part of a widespread or systematic attack directed against a civilian population.
They added that there was no state or organizational policy to commit murder.
They urged the International Criminal Court to allow the killings to be prosecuted domestically, saying Philippine courts and justice institutions are capable of handling the cases.



The Ombudsman has ordered the filing of graft charges against three former Land Bank of the Philippines, or LBP, officials and a businessman.


This is over alleged irregularities in the approval and renewal of loans worth up to ₱115 million to American Boulevard Trading Corporation, or ABTC.
The respondents were identified as LBP First Vice President Lolita Silva, former Assistant Vice President Danilo Dayanghirang, former Account Officer Ronaldo Robles, and ABTC President and Chairman Alberto Ching.
The Ombudsman noted that there was prima facie evidence with reasonable certainty of conviction against the four for violating the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.


Public Works Secretary Giovanni Lopez is challenging contractors, investors, and other private-sector players to help clean up the DPWH.


Lopez urged them not to participate in schemes that enable public officials to misuse government funds.
He said they should reject bribery, questionable transactions, and other irregularities.
He warned that the fight against corruption cannot succeed without their cooperation.


Six brand-new Chinook helicopters are expected to be delivered to the Philippines by 2029.


This was disclosed by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro.
He said the helicopters are part of the $2.4-billion U.S. defense deal announced by President Donald Trump during his Manila visit.
The Chinook is the heavy-lift helicopter of choice for the U.S. Army.
It is used for cargo and troop transport, search and rescue, casualty evacuation, special operations, and disaster relief.

snippet.title: Movie scenes ruined by extras. #marvel #movie #foryou #usa #fyp
snippet.description:
First, *The Avengers*. When the Chitauri army attacked New York, many civilians were fleeing for their lives. And Clint, Steve, and Natasha were helping those in danger. There's a moment when a civilian in a blue-and-white striped shirt is caught on camera running down the street. It looks like he doesn't need any help at all.

Second, *Airplane!*. My favorite scene is the one where the plane crashes through the window. If you look closely, you'll see a baby. Right as everyone is trying to escape, someone actually tossed a baby into the air, right at the moment the window shatters.

Third, *Quantum of Solace*. There's an extra behind Bond who clearly hasn't swept a floor in his entire life. The crew probably didn't let him actually sweep for the sake of the sound effects, but the shot is so obvious it had me cracking up.

Next, Marvel's extras are much more skilled at sweeping. Only, the moment Captain America first got his shield, he was already sweeping, and even after Cap finished using the shield, he was still sweeping the same spot.

Fifth, *The Abyss*. When the tsunami comes, the people on the beach are frantically running. And at this critical moment, an extra's pants get pulled down by his mischievous friend. Luckily, he reacted quickly and pulled them back up.

snippet.title: «Ақ жеңге» телехикаясы. 33-бөлім / Телесериал «Ак женге». 33-серия (субтитры на рус) Тұсаукесер!
snippet.description:
Ауыл өмірінің шынайы тыныс-тіршілігін бейнелеп, отбасы құндылықтарын арқау еткен жаңа туындыны жуырда «Хабар» арнасынан тамашалай аласыздар. 

Оқиға ауылдағы қара шаңырақтан басталады. Әнуар атаның үш ұлы бар. Бір жыл бұрын кемпірі дүние салған. Аналарының жылдық асына келгенде үлкен ұлының келіншегі Жібек көңіл-күйі түскен атасын көріп, ауылда қалуға шешім қабылдайды. Сол сәттен бастап қарашаңырақтың берекесі кіріп, ынтымағы артады.

Жібектің ролінде танымал актриса, әнші Кәмшат Жолдыбаева. Өзі де жар, келін, ана атанған актриса біраз жыл үзілістен соң түсірілім алаңына қайта оралды.

snippet.title: Saudis drawn into regional war | India’s New Bill Sparks North-South divide | Jahan Numa |BBC URDU
snippet.description:
نو ماہ پہلے جب امریکہ اور اسرائیل نے ایران کو جوہری اسلحے کے حصول سے روکنے اور حکمرانوں کو تبدیل کرنے کے لیے جنگ کا آغاز کیا، تو سعودی عرب نے اس جھگڑے سے خود کو علیحدہ رکھنے کی کوشش کی لیکن اب سعودی عرب خطے میں جاری جنگ میں بری طرح الجھ گیا ہے۔ حوثی مسلسل سعودی عرب پر حملے کر رہے ہیں۔

خود کو محفوظ رکھنے کے لیے سعودی عرب نے پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے ساتھ  مکہ دفاعی معاہدہ کیا جو اب نافذ العمل ہو چکا ہے لیکن ایران کے حمایت یافتہ حوثی ملیشیا مسلسل سعودی عرب پر حملے کر رہے ہیں اور انھوں نے اہم آبی گزر گاہ باب المندب پر اپنی گرفت مضبوط کر لی ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ انڈیا میں ایک نیا بل پیش کیا جا رہا ہے جو اگر منظور ہو گیا تو وہ ملک کے جنوب اور شمال میں ایک بڑی کشیدگی کا باعث بن سکتا ہے۔

پریزینٹر: خالد کرامت
